subject: Stellarus onboarding coordination and sprint roster
messages:
From: Samir Basu <samir@stellarushealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: leah.monroe@stellarushealth.com
Date: 2028-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + target go-live and MAP kickoff

Kimberly —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Stellarus is keen to move faster on the pilot integration. Our target is to have a production-safe integration by 2029-01-31 (we know it’s ambitious). Can you send a mutual action plan (high-level milestones, owners, rough dates) and a short checklist for security/network requirements so we can align internal teams?

Primary goals:
- Sandbox access and data ingest test by 2028-12-08
- Security review complete by 2028-12-22
- Pilot validation and live traffic ramp by 2029-01-31

Attaching our network diagram and internal contact for procurement (Leah). We expect procurement to need ~3 weeks once SOW is approved.

Thanks — we’re excited to get this moving.

Samir
Director, Digital Platforms
Stellarus Health

Attachment: stellarus_network_diagram.pdf (network diagram, 1 page)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Basu <samir@stellarushealth.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Leah Monroe <leah.monroe@stellarushealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-15T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + target go-live and MAP kickoff

Samir —

Appreciate the clear target. I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Playbook (attached) with milestone dates, owners, and a short dependencies checklist. High level below — full tracker attached (stellarus_map_v1.xlsx).

Summary milestones (proposed):
- 2028-11-20 — MAP kickoff call (stakeholders: Stellarus dev, security, procurement; Redwood AM, CS, Solutions) — owner: kimberly_park
- 2028-12-01 — Sandbox credentials & sample ingest (owner: aditya_rao)
- 2028-12-15 — Model selection + quantization profile agreed (owner: karthik_iyer)
- 2028-12-22 — Security questionnaire + network review completed (owner: stephanie_nguyen)
- 2029-01-12 — Pilot validation (owner: Stellarus product lead)
- 2029-01-31 — Live traffic cutover (owner: kimberly_park)

Immediate asks for your team before the kickoff:
1) Confirm stakeholders who will attend the kickoff (Dev lead, Security, Procurement contact — Leah noted).
2) Share any nonstandard compliance requirements beyond HIPAA (e.g., retention, regional controls).
3) If you have a target budget window, that helps us prioritize Dedicated vs Hosted options in the SOW.

I’ve included: 1) quick dependency map in the spreadsheet, 2) a short security checklist (ports, IP allowlist, certs), and 3) a suggested cadence for weekly sprint syncs + a biweekly steering call during ramp.

Proposed kickoff slots: 2028-11-20 09:00-10:00 PT OR 2028-11-20 13:00-14:00 PT — which works for you?

I’ll also open a Jira ticket for the implementation epic and add an initial backlog.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: stellarus_map_v1.xlsx (Mutual Action Playbook, live spreadsheet)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samir Basu <samir@stellarushealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-15T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + target go-live and MAP kickoff

On Thu, Nov 15, 2028 at 12:05 PM kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference> wrote:
> I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Playbook (attached) with milestone dates, owners, and a short dependencies checklist.
> 
Thanks Kim — quick notes from CS perspective:
- I’ll own the weekly sprint sync invites and the acceptance criteria template for pilot validation.
- For security review: we need the Stellarus security questionnaire returned by 2028-11-29 to hit the 12/22 target (we’ll do a 1-hour doc walkthrough on 12/05).
- For Sandbox access: Aditya — can you confirm the token expiry policy and sample payload size limits? If not, we should relax the ingest size for the sandbox.

Risks to flag in the MAP (to communicate to customer):
- Procurement latency — if SOW goes late, target production date will slip (we recommended a 2-week procurement buffer).
- Custom quantization work may add 1–2 sprints depending on the model variant.

I’ll draft the acceptance criteria and attach to the tracker today.

— Stephanie
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

(quoted for context)

From: Samir Basu <samir@stellarushealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: Leah Monroe <leah.monroe@stellarushealth.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-16T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + target go-live and MAP kickoff

Thanks, Kimberly & Stephanie — this is helpful. 13:00 PT on 11/20 works for our team.

Confirming stakeholders:
- Samir Basu, Dir Digital Platforms (me)
- Leah Monroe, Procurement (leah.monroe@stellarushealth.com)
- Priya Nambiar, Security (copied on calendar invite to follow)
- Alex Chen, Integrations (will join dev portion)

Procurement note: Leah says once she has the finalized SOW she needs approximately 3 business weeks to complete PO. Please include a placeholder SOW and ballpark estimate in the shared folder so procurement can start internal reviews.

Can you also send the initial SOW + estimate and a DocuSign link for procurement to review before the kickoff? That will speed things up.

Samir

Attachment: none

(please add Priya Nambiar to the invite; I will forward her details)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Samir Basu <samir@stellarushealth.com>, Leah Monroe <leah.monroe@stellarushealth.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-17T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Updated MAP, SOW stub, and kickoff calendar invite (11/20 13:00 PT)

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. I scheduled the kickoff for 2028-11-20 13:00 PT and shared calendar invites with the contacts we have. Priya — welcome, please let me know if you need the questionnaire in a different format.

Actions completed (attached to thread and Drive):
- stellarus_map_v1.xlsx — updated with owners and acceptance criteria (tab: Milestones).
- SOW_stellarus_v1.pdf — placeholder SOW and ballpark pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated options.
- Created Jira epic: RED-IMP-10234 (implementation epic + initial backlog).

Next internal asks (Redwood):
- Karthik: confirm quantization/variant estimate so we can lock the timeline for 12/15 milestone.
- Aditya: confirm sandbox token TTL and ingest limits; I added a sandbox access task in the spreadsheet.
- Stephanie: share the acceptance criteria doc in the tracker by EOD 11/18.

I’ll also upload a DocuSign draft for Leah’s review and link it in the Drive. Leah — when you have a moment, can procurement confirm the internal PO lead and preferred billing contact?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
